personal_devices_description: These settings are shared across all your personal devices.
empty_nearby_description: Devices on your local network will be detected automatically.
add_contact_intro: You can add anyone, wherever they are. Just paste their contact ticket below, or send them yours:
add_contact_ticket_hint: Your ticket is right above. You can also copy it anytime with “Copy contact ticket” in your profile menu, at the bottom left of the app.
storage_peers_description: Discovered peers are stored temporarily. Clear them all with this option. Your saved contacts will not be affected.
device_request_description: {{peer}} wants this device to be added to their personal devices.
blocked_devices_description: Blocked devices can’t find you or send you files. Manage those devices here.
device_pairing_code_description: Enter this code on the other device to add it to your personal devices.
device_pairing_accepted_description: Adding the device to your personal devices…
device_pairing_success_description: This device is now part of your personal devices.
device_pairing_error_generic: Something went wrong while pairing. Please try again.
device_pairing_error_declined: The other device declined the pairing request.
device_pairing_error_busy: The other device is busy with another pairing. Try again in a moment.
device_pairing_error_code_mismatch: The pairing codes didn't match. Try again.
device_pairing_error_already_in_family: The other device already belongs to another group of personal devices.
device_pairing_error_timeout: The other device didn't respond in time.
leave_devices_description_one: Remove this device from your personal devices. It will stop syncing your clipboard and settings.
leave_devices_description_other: Remove this device from your {{count}} personal devices. It will stop syncing your clipboard and settings.
left_devices: This device left your personal devices
